dedupe_keys.name: siflo gama agent based model of inhabitants protection and evacuation behaviour during an urban flood

description: SiFlo simulates floods in urban areas together with how inhabitants react. It was built on the GAMA platform by Patrick Taillandier, Franck Taillandier, Pascal Di Maiolo and Rasool Mehdizadeh and published in the CoMSES library in 2021. Water flows over the city while inhabitants choose among protecting their house and belongings, evacuating by road through a traffic model, and getting or passing on information with imperfect knowledge. Their behaviour includes emotions, following or ignoring instructions and interfering with one another. The model also closes flooded roads, treats them as dangerous, and considers the state of protection infrastructure such as dykes. Version 1.0.0 is available as a free download from CoMSES under the GPL-3.0 licence and runs in the free GAMA platform. Caveats: the page does not name the calibration site or report validation, and the behaviour model needs many parameters. Coverage is general for urban floods. Simulation uses: testing warning, evacuation and road closure strategies for emergency services during floods. Related records: the Rouen evacuation model (model-comses-rouen-evacuation-gama-driving) uses the same platform for city-scale road evacuation.
inputs: Urban terrain, road network and buildings
Flood water flow and dyke state
name: SiFlo: GAMA agent-based model of inhabitants' protection and evacuation behaviour during an urban flood
outputs: Inhabitant actions (protecting homes, evacuating, sharing information), road closures and damage
